steps.en: Install the skill into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的 agent

steps.en: On the first diagram in a project, sees the style guide is still default and stops to ask
steps.zh: 项目里第一次出图时，发现样式表还是默认值，先停下来问你

steps.en: Extracts palette and fonts, shows a diff, writes the tokens into its style guide
steps.zh: 抽出配色和字体，给你看 diff，再把 token 写进样式表

steps.en: Ask for a diagram in plain words
steps.code: Make me an architecture diagram of my app

steps.en: States type, size and cuts, then writes one self-contained HTML file with inline SVG in your brand
steps.zh: 先报图型、尺寸和删减，再写出套好品牌、内嵌 SVG 的单个 HTML

value.en: A publishable diagram that matches your site, without a Figma session or the generic rounded-box look
value.zh: 不用开 Figma 磨半小时，也不再是千篇一律的圆角框：拿到就能发、和你网站一个调性的图

sources: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design README.md 'Onboarding' flow block and 'First-run gate' (onboard diagram-design to https://yoursite.com)
https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design README.md opening prompts (Make me an architecture diagram of my app: frontend, backend, database, Redis cache.)
https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design README.md 'It's working if…' (agent states type, pattern, size and planned cuts, then renders one .html)
local run 2026-10-10 in a shallow clone: python3 skills/diagram-design/scripts/self_check.py assets/example-architecture-delta.html -> OK
